headlines.article_text: Anthropic IPO live updates: ANT stock price and Nasdaq debut Skip Navigation Markets Business Investing Tech Politics & Policy Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu watch now VIDEO 5:16 05:16 Anthropic raises $81B+ in historic IPO: Here's what to know Squawk Box Anthropic is set for its long-awaited Nasdaq debut on Thursday, after the artificial intelligence lab raised over $81 billion in a record IPO , surpassing SpaceX 's offering in June. The Claude creator sold 980 million shares at $83 a piece on Wednesday, lifting the size and price of its offering. Its fully diluted market cap sits at around $1.5 trillion. The 5-year-old company captivated the corporate world with its Claude AI models and products, which have fueled its meteoric rise this year. Anthropic said in its prospectus that it generated $33.24 billion in revenue for the nine months ended Sept. 30, up a staggering 1,200% from the same period last year. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei co-founded the company in 2021 after he and a small group of researchers defected from OpenAI , now its chief rival. Anthropic has faced sharp criticism over its positions on safety, regulation and national security, including by President Donald Trump and other senior government officials. The company will list on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol "ANT," and its debut will be a big test for the AI industry. Investors have been fretting over Jensen Huang's sudden ouster at Nvidia , voters' stinging rebuke of AI during the midterm elections and the feasibility of a multitrillion-dollar infrastructure buildout . "Our aim is to help humankind chart a safe course through this technological evolution, open new frontiers of discovery, and bring forth an age of miracles," Anthropic's co-founders wrote in the company's prospectus. "Everyone who owns our stock, whether an institution or an individual, becomes part of that effort." Highlights so far: Daniela Amodei gives a shoutout to mom Dario Amodei addresses debt and landing an investment-grade credit rating Spotted: Executives sporting "Clawd" pins at Nasdaq Dario Amodei renews pledge to pace frontier AI development Retail demand for ANT was the largest in history Anthropic employees set to get rich CNBC's reporters are covering Anthropic's IPO live on air and online from our bureaus in San Francisco and Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey, and from the Nasdaq in New York City. VIDEO 15:11 15:11 Watch CNBC’s full interview with Anthropic co-founders Dario and Daniela Amodei 3 Min Ago Anthropic’s strained relationship with the Trump administration President Donald Trump speaks at the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, in Washington, D.C., Nov. 2, 2026. Finn Gomez | Getty Images News | Getty Images Anthropic has had two major disputes with the Trump administration this year, but tensions have begun to thaw between the two camps in recent months. Amodei joined Trump for a private dinner at the White House in September, which marked the first one-on-one meeting between the two leaders. Days later, Amodei attended a luncheon at the White House, where he signed a voluntary AI safety accord. Three months earlier, the company had to temporarily disable access to two of its most advanced models, Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5, in order to comply with an export control directive from the government that cited "national security authorities." Anthropic restored the models after roughly two weeks of tense negotiations. In March, Anthropic was banned by the Pentagon after discussions about how the military could use its AI models spiraled out of control. The company sued the Trump administration to try to reverse the blacklisting. — Ashley Capoot 10 Min Ago How to get Anthropic stock — without buying the IPO Retail investors who don't want to buy Anthropic stock directly will get access to the AI startup courtesy of many popular mutual funds and exchange-traded funds . Index funds won't add Anthropic stock immediately. Some will add them within days or weeks, depending the inclusion rules of specific indexes. For example, the Morningstar U.S. Total Market Index will add the stock after five trading days. The Nasdaq-100 will add it after Dec. 18. The S&P 500 won't add it for at least a year. Many actively managed funds held pre-IPO Anthropic shares — and investors in those funds automatically get a sliver of Anthropic's IPO when it starts trading. A handful of the most heavily concentrated funds held pre-IPO shares worth more than 10% of their overall portfolios. Most investors' exposure to Anthropic in mutual funds and ETFs will likely be relatively low — well below 1% of the overall portfolio for most funds, experts said. — Greg Iacurci 14 Min Ago Daniela Amodei gives shoutout to mom watch now VIDEO 0:54 00:54 Anthropic’s sibling founders reflect on IPO journey: 'I hope you are watching. If you are, hi, Mom!' Squawk on the Street Daniela Amodei said she and Dario are "so proud" of the Anthropic team. "Dario and I were talking about this beforehand: This is such an incredible milestone," she said. "It's such a huge moment for the company. We're so proud of what the team has done to get us here, and also, we're the same company." "We're so excited to continue pursuing our mission. I think that's the thing we're both really focused on, and also we're hoping to be able to spend a little more time together, just the two of us as siblings, after this is over," she added. Daniela also shouted out the siblings' mom. "I hope you're watching. If you are, hi, Mom!," she said. — Ashley Capoot 20 Min Ago No updates on clash with Pentagon Daniela Amodei said there were no significant updates on Anthropic's clash with Department to Defense but expects the company's relationship with the government to continue. "My feeling, honestly, at Anthropic is that we have always worked extremely well with the national security apparatus of the United States of America. We're very committed to ensuring that Claude is helping to protect the nation. We've had an incredible working relationship with with that entire part of the government, really since Anthropic was founded, and we expect that that will continue." — Caleigh Keating 24 Min Ago Dario Amodei says $900 billion commitments don't 'seem so large' Dario Amodei defended the company's massive $900 billion in AI commitments. "If you look at the amount of cash we have on the balance sheet and the amount of revenue that we're already making per year, suddenly those commitments don't seem so large," he said. Amodei said the company tries to "err on the low side" when predicting compute. — Samantha Subin 26 Min Ago Dario Amodei: Anthropic 'enjoying' working with SpaceX Dario Amodei, Co-Founder and CEO of Anthropic speaking with CNBC ahead of the Anthropic IPO on Nov. 19th, 2026.
